metadata.name: Container Runtime Security Baseline (Docker/Podman)
metadata.description: Template de securitate pentru containere Docker si Podman bazat pe CIS Docker Benchmark si bune practici din industrie. Verifica configuratia de securitate a fiecarui container in parte: privilege escalation, namespace sharing, capabilities, filesystem safety, image hygiene si configuratie runtime. Fiecare verificare automata tinteste un container specific folosind {{CONTAINER_ID}} si {{RUNTIME}} injectate de platforma.
metadata.author: BitTrail Platform

controls.title: Container Privilege Escalation & Root Execution
controls.rationale: Containere privilegiate sau rulate ca root permit escaladarea privilegiilor catre gazda. Aceasta este una din cele mai critice greseli de configurare in medii containerizate.

automatedChecks.title: Container ruleaza in mod privilegiat
automatedChecks.description: Detectie flag --privileged care acorda acces deplin la dispozitivele gazdei
automatedChecks.command: {{RUNTIME}} inspect --format '{{.HostConfig.Privileged}}' {{CONTAINER_ID}} 2>/dev/null
automatedChecks.onFailMessage: Containerul ruleaza in mod privilegiat. Aceasta acorda acces complet la dispozitivele gazdei si trebuie evitat.

automatedChecks.title: Utilizatorul implicit din container (root detection)
automatedChecks.description: Verifica daca procesul principal din container ruleaza ca root (UID 0)
automatedChecks.command: USER=$({{RUNTIME}} inspect --format '{{.Config.User}}' {{CONTAINER_ID}} 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$USER" ] || [ "$USER" = '0' ] || [ "$USER" = 'root' ]; then echo 'USER=root'; echo 'CHECK=FAIL'; else echo "USER=$USER"; echo 'CHECK=PASS'; fi
automatedChecks.onFailMessage: Containerul ruleaza ca root. Specificati un utilizator non-root in Dockerfile (USER <uid>) sau la runtime (--user).

automatedChecks.title: Privilege escalation (no-new-privileges)
automatedChecks.description: Verifica daca flagul no-new-privileges este setat pentru a preveni SUID/SGID escalation
automatedChecks.command: RESULT=$({{RUNTIME}} inspect --format '{{.HostConfig.SecurityOpt}}' {{CONTAINER_ID}} 2>/dev/null); if echo "$RESULT" | grep -q 'no-new-privileges'; then echo 'NO_NEW_PRIVS=true'; echo 'CHECK=PASS'; else echo 'NO_NEW_PRIVS=false'; echo 'CHECK=FAIL'; fi
automatedChecks.onFailMessage: Flagul no-new-privileges nu este setat. Adaugati --security-opt no-new-privileges:true la rulare.

manualChecks.title: Revizie politici de access management pentru containere
manualChecks.description: Exista politici clare care definesc ce containere pot fi rulate privilegiat si procesul de aprobare?
manualChecks.instructions: Verificati documentatia interna si confirmati existenta unui proces de aprobare pentru containere privilegiate.

controls.title: Host Namespace Sharing
controls.rationale: Partajarea namespace-urilor de retea, PID sau IPC cu gazda elimina izolarea containerului si poate permite atacuri de tip container escape.

automatedChecks.title: Host network namespace (--network=host)
automatedChecks.description: Detectie partajare stack de retea cu gazda
automatedChecks.command: RESULT=$({{RUNTIME}} inspect --format '{{.HostConfig.NetworkMode}}' {{CONTAINER_ID}} 2>/dev/null); echo "NETWORK_MODE=$RESULT"; if [ "$RESULT" = 'host' ]; then echo 'CHECK=FAIL'; else echo 'CHECK=PASS'; fi
automatedChecks.onFailMessage: Containerul partajeaza namespace-ul de retea cu gazda (--network=host). Aceasta elimina izolarea retelei.

automatedChecks.title: Host PID namespace (--pid=host)
automatedChecks.description: Detectie partajare spatiu PID cu gazda
automatedChecks.command: RESULT=$({{RUNTIME}} inspect --format '{{.HostConfig.PidMode}}' {{CONTAINER_ID}} 2>/dev/null); echo "PID_MODE=$RESULT"; if [ "$RESULT" = 'host' ]; then echo 'CHECK=FAIL'; else echo 'CHECK=PASS'; fi
automatedChecks.onFailMessage: Containerul partajeaza namespace-ul PID cu gazda. Procesele din container pot vedea si interactiona cu procesele gazdei.

automatedChecks.title: Host IPC namespace (--ipc=host)
automatedChecks.description: Detectie partajare IPC (shared memory, semafoare) cu gazda
automatedChecks.command: RESULT=$({{RUNTIME}} inspect --format '{{.HostConfig.IpcMode}}' {{CONTAINER_ID}} 2>/dev/null); echo "IPC_MODE=$RESULT"; if [ "$RESULT" = 'host' ] || [ "$RESULT" = 'shareable' ]; then echo 'CHECK=WARN'; else echo 'CHECK=PASS'; fi
automatedChecks.onFailMessage: Containerul partajeaza namespace-ul IPC cu gazda sau alte containere. Aceasta poate permite atacuri de tip shared memory.

controls.title: Linux Capabilities & Security Profiles
controls.rationale: Capabilities Linux adaugate explicit pot permite escaladarea privilegiilor. Profilurile seccomp si AppArmor/SELinux limiteaza syscall-urile disponibile containerului.

automatedChecks.title: Capabilities adaugate (CapAdd)
automatedChecks.description: Lista capabilities adaugate explicit containerului
automatedChecks.command: CAPS=$({{RUNTIME}} inspect --format '{{.HostConfig.CapAdd}}' {{CONTAINER_ID}} 2>/dev/null); echo "CAP_ADD=$CAPS"; if [ -z "$CAPS" ] || [ "$CAPS" = '[]' ] || [ "$CAPS" = '<nil>' ]; then echo 'CHECK=PASS'; else echo 'CHECK=WARN'; fi
automatedChecks.onFailMessage: Containerul are capabilities adaugate explicit. Verificati daca sunt necesare si documentati rationale.

automatedChecks.title: CAP_SYS_ADMIN — capability periculoasa
automatedChecks.description: CAP_SYS_ADMIN este echivalent cu root deplin si trebuie evitat
automatedChecks.command: CAPS=$({{RUNTIME}} inspect --format '{{.HostConfig.CapAdd}}' {{CONTAINER_ID}} 2>/dev/null); if echo "$CAPS" | grep -qi 'SYS_ADMIN\|ALL'; then echo 'CAP_SYS_ADMIN=PRESENT'; echo 'CHECK=FAIL'; else echo 'CAP_SYS_ADMIN=ABSENT'; echo 'CHECK=PASS'; fi
automatedChecks.onFailMessage: Containerul are CAP_SYS_ADMIN sau ALL capabilities. Aceasta este o problema critica de securitate.

automatedChecks.title: Profil seccomp aplicat
automatedChecks.description: Verifica daca un profil seccomp este aplicat (restrictioneaza syscall-uri)
automatedChecks.command: RESULT=$({{RUNTIME}} inspect --format '{{.HostConfig.SecurityOpt}}' {{CONTAINER_ID}} 2>/dev/null); echo "SECURITY_OPT=$RESULT"; if echo "$RESULT" | grep -qi 'seccomp'; then echo 'SECCOMP=APPLIED'; echo 'CHECK=PASS'; elif [ "$RESULT" = '[]' ] || [ -z "$RESULT" ]; then echo 'SECCOMP=DEFAULT'; echo 'CHECK=PASS'; else echo 'SECCOMP=UNKNOWN'; echo 'CHECK=PASS'; fi
automatedChecks.onFailMessage: Nu se poate determina profilul seccomp aplicat.

automatedChecks.title: AppArmor / SELinux label aplicat
automatedChecks.description: Verifica daca un label AppArmor sau SELinux este aplicat containerului
automatedChecks.command: RESULT=$({{RUNTIME}} inspect --format '{{.HostConfig.SecurityOpt}}' {{CONTAINER_ID}} 2>/dev/null); if echo "$RESULT" | grep -qiE 'apparmor|label'; then echo 'MAC_PROFILE=APPLIED'; echo 'CHECK=PASS'; else echo 'MAC_PROFILE=MISSING'; echo 'CHECK=WARN'; fi
automatedChecks.onFailMessage: Nu este aplicat niciun profil AppArmor sau SELinux. Adaugati --security-opt apparmor=<profile> pentru control mai strict.

manualChecks.title: Revizie capabilities necesare
manualChecks.description: Documentati si justificati fiecare capability adaugata explicit
manualChecks.instructions: Lista capabilities adaugate si confirmati ca fiecare este necesara si minima pentru functionalitatea ceruta.

controls.title: Filesystem Safety & Mount Security
controls.rationale: Filesystem-ul read-only si restrictionarea mount-urilor sensibile reduc semnificativ suprafata de atac. Montarea docker.sock in container este echivalenta cu acces root pe gazda.

automatedChecks.title: Filesystem radacina read-only
automatedChecks.description: Verifica daca filesystem-ul radacina al containerului este mounted read-only
automatedChecks.command: RESULT=$({{RUNTIME}} inspect --format '{{.HostConfig.ReadonlyRootfs}}' {{CONTAINER_ID}} 2>/dev/null); echo "READONLY_ROOTFS=$RESULT"; if [ "$RESULT" = 'true' ]; then echo 'CHECK=PASS'; else echo 'CHECK=WARN'; fi
automatedChecks.onFailMessage: Filesystem-ul radacina nu este read-only. Utilizati --read-only si montati volume temporare pentru date mutabile.

automatedChecks.title: Docker/Podman socket montat in container
automatedChecks.description: Detectie montare /var/run/docker.sock sau /run/podman/podman.sock in container
automatedChecks.command: MOUNTS=$({{RUNTIME}} inspect --format '{{json .Mounts}}' {{CONTAINER_ID}} 2>/dev/null); if echo "$MOUNTS" | grep -qE 'docker\.sock|podman\.sock'; then echo 'SOCKET_MOUNT=DETECTED'; echo 'CHECK=FAIL'; else echo 'SOCKET_MOUNT=NONE'; echo 'CHECK=PASS'; fi
automatedChecks.onFailMessage: CRITIC: Socket-ul Docker/Podman este montat in container. Aceasta acorda control deplin al daemon-ului runtime si este echivalent cu root pe gazda.

automatedChecks.title: Mount-uri catre directoare sensibile ale gazdei
automatedChecks.description: Detectie bind mounts catre /etc, /proc, /sys, /root, /home pe gazda
automatedChecks.command: MOUNTS=$({{RUNTIME}} inspect --format '{{json .Mounts}}' {{CONTAINER_ID}} 2>/dev/null); SENSITIVE=$(echo "$MOUNTS" | grep -oE '"Source":"/?(etc|proc|sys|root|home|usr/bin|usr/sbin)[^"]*"' | wc -l); echo "SENSITIVE_MOUNTS=$SENSITIVE"; if [ "$SENSITIVE" -gt 0 ]; then echo 'CHECK=WARN'; echo "$MOUNTS" | grep -oE '"Source":"/?(etc|proc|sys|root|home|usr/bin|usr/sbin)[^"]*"'; else echo 'CHECK=PASS'; fi
automatedChecks.onFailMessage: Containerul are mount-uri catre directoare sensibile ale gazdei. Revizuiti necesitatea fiecarui mount.

automatedChecks.title: Mount-uri cu acces read-write (inventar)
automatedChecks.description: Lista tuturor bind mounts cu acces read-write
automatedChecks.command: MOUNTS=$({{RUNTIME}} inspect --format '{{json .Mounts}}' {{CONTAINER_ID}} 2>/dev/null); RW_MOUNTS=$(echo "$MOUNTS" | grep -c '"RW":true' 2>/dev/null || echo 0); echo "RW_MOUNTS=$RW_MOUNTS"; echo 'CHECK=PASS'

manualChecks.title: Revizie bind mounts — justificare si principiu least-privilege
manualChecks.description: Fiecare volume/bind mount trebuie justificat si limitat la permisiuni minime
manualChecks.instructions: Analizati lista de mounts si confirmati ca fiecare este necesar, documentat si are permisiunile minime (RO unde posibil).

controls.title: Image Hygiene & Supply Chain
controls.rationale: Imaginile cu tag :latest nu sunt reproductibile si pot introduce cod neverificat. Lipsa digest pinning face imposibila verificarea integritatii imaginii la rulare.

automatedChecks.title: Tag :latest utilizat
automatedChecks.description: Containerul foloseste tag :latest care nu garanteaza reproducibilitate
automatedChecks.command: IMAGE=$({{RUNTIME}} inspect --format '{{.Config.Image}}' {{CONTAINER_ID}} 2>/dev/null); echo "IMAGE=$IMAGE"; if echo "$IMAGE" | grep -qE ':latest$|^[^:]+$'; then echo 'LATEST_TAG=YES'; echo 'CHECK=FAIL'; else echo 'LATEST_TAG=NO'; echo 'CHECK=PASS'; fi
automatedChecks.onFailMessage: Imaginea foloseste tag :latest. Specificati un tag de versiune precisa sau un digest SHA256 pentru reproducibilitate.

automatedChecks.title: Digest pinning verificat
automatedChecks.description: Verifica daca imaginea a fost trasa cu digest SHA256 explicit
automatedChecks.command: DIGESTS=$({{RUNTIME}} inspect --format '{{json .RepoDigests}}' {{CONTAINER_ID}} 2>/dev/null); echo "REPO_DIGESTS=$DIGESTS"; if [ "$DIGESTS" = '[]' ] || [ "$DIGESTS" = 'null' ] || [ -z "$DIGESTS" ]; then echo 'DIGEST_PINNED=NO'; echo 'CHECK=WARN'; else echo 'DIGEST_PINNED=YES'; echo 'CHECK=PASS'; fi
automatedChecks.onFailMessage: Imaginea nu are digest SHA256 disponibil. Preferati imagini trase cu @sha256:<hash> pentru garantarea integritatii.

automatedChecks.title: Registry surs?? imagine (inventar)
automatedChecks.description: Identifica registry-ul din care a fost trasa imaginea
automatedChecks.command: IMAGE=$({{RUNTIME}} inspect --format '{{.Config.Image}}' {{CONTAINER_ID}} 2>/dev/null); REGISTRY=$(echo "$IMAGE" | awk -F/ 'NF>2{print $1}NF==2{print $1}NF==1{print "docker.io"}'); echo "REGISTRY=$REGISTRY"; echo 'CHECK=PASS'

manualChecks.title: Politica de imagini aprobate si process de scanning
manualChecks.description: Exista o lista de registry-uri aprobate si un proces de scanare a vulnerabilitatilor (SCA/SAST) pentru imagini?
manualChecks.instructions: Confirmati existenta policies pentru imagini: registry whitelist, scanning obligatoriu (Trivy/Grype), si semnare (cosign/notary).

controls.title: Runtime Configuration Safety
controls.rationale: Politicile de restart necontrolate, lipsa limitelor de resurse si porturile publicate forteaza administrative overhead si pot expune servicii nedorit.

automatedChecks.title: Politica restart (restart policy)
automatedChecks.description: Inventar politica de restart configured pe container
automatedChecks.command: POLICY=$({{RUNTIME}} inspect --format '{{.HostConfig.RestartPolicy.Name}}' {{CONTAINER_ID}} 2>/dev/null); MAX=$({{RUNTIME}} inspect --format '{{.HostConfig.RestartPolicy.MaximumRetryCount}}' {{CONTAINER_ID}} 2>/dev/null); echo "RESTART_POLICY=$POLICY"; echo "MAX_RETRY=$MAX"; echo 'CHECK=PASS'

automatedChecks.title: Limite de memorie configurate
automatedChecks.description: Verifica daca exista limite de memorie pentru a preveni OOM pe gazda
automatedChecks.command: MEM=$({{RUNTIME}} inspect --format '{{.HostConfig.Memory}}' {{CONTAINER_ID}} 2>/dev/null); echo "MEMORY_LIMIT=$MEM"; if [ "$MEM" = '0' ] || [ -z "$MEM" ]; then echo 'MEMORY_LIMIT=NONE'; echo 'CHECK=WARN'; else echo 'MEMORY_LIMIT=SET'; echo 'CHECK=PASS'; fi
automatedChecks.onFailMessage: Nu sunt configurate limite de memorie. Fara limit, un container poate consuma toata memoria gazdei, cauzand OOM.

automatedChecks.title: Porturi publicate (inventar)
automatedChecks.description: Lista porturilor expuse din container catre gazda
automatedChecks.command: PORTS=$({{RUNTIME}} inspect --format '{{json .NetworkSettings.Ports}}' {{CONTAINER_ID}} 2>/dev/null); echo "PORTS=$PORTS"; echo 'CHECK=PASS'

automatedChecks.title: Healthcheck configurat
automatedChecks.description: Verifica daca imaginea/containerul are un healthcheck definit
automatedChecks.command: HC=$({{RUNTIME}} inspect --format '{{json .Config.Healthcheck}}' {{CONTAINER_ID}} 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$HC" ] || [ "$HC" = 'null' ] || echo "$HC" | grep -q 'NONE'; then echo 'HEALTHCHECK=MISSING'; echo 'CHECK=WARN'; else echo 'HEALTHCHECK=CONFIGURED'; echo 'CHECK=PASS'; fi
automatedChecks.onFailMessage: Containerul nu are healthcheck configurat. Fara healthcheck, orchestratorii nu pot detecta stari de eroare.

automatedChecks.title: Numar variabile de mediu (fara valori)
automatedChecks.description: Numara variabilele de mediu transmise containerului (fara a expune valorile)
automatedChecks.command: COUNT=$({{RUNTIME}} inspect --format '{{len .Config.Env}}' {{CONTAINER_ID}} 2>/dev/null); echo "ENV_VAR_COUNT=$COUNT"; if [ "$COUNT" -gt 50 ]; then echo 'ENV_VARS=HIGH'; echo 'CHECK=WARN'; else echo 'CHECK=PASS'; fi
automatedChecks.onFailMessage: Containerul are un numar mare de variabile de mediu. Verificati ca secretele nu sunt transmise prin ENV ci prin mecanisme dedicate (Vault, Kubernetes Secrets).

automatedChecks.title: Limite CPU configurate
automatedChecks.description: Verifica daca exista cota CPU pentru a preveni starvation pe gazda
automatedChecks.command: CPU=$({{RUNTIME}} inspect --format '{{.HostConfig.CpuQuota}}' {{CONTAINER_ID}} 2>/dev/null); CPUSHARES=$({{RUNTIME}} inspect --format '{{.HostConfig.CpuShares}}' {{CONTAINER_ID}} 2>/dev/null); echo "CPU_QUOTA=$CPU"; echo "CPU_SHARES=$CPUSHARES"; if [ "$CPU" = '0' ] && [ "$CPUSHARES" = '0' ]; then echo 'CPU_LIMIT=NONE'; echo 'CHECK=WARN'; else echo 'CPU_LIMIT=SET'; echo 'CHECK=PASS'; fi
automatedChecks.onFailMessage: Nu sunt configurate limite CPU. Fara cotă CPU, un container poate monopoliza resursele gazdei.

manualChecks.title: Revizie variabile de mediu — secretele nu sunt in ENV
manualChecks.description: Confirmati ca secretele (parole, token-uri, chei API) NU sunt transmise prin variabile de mediu
manualChecks.instructions: Analizati configuratia deployment (docker-compose, helm, k8s yaml) si confirmati ca secretele sunt gestionate prin Vault, Kubernetes Secrets sau echivalent, nu prin ENV.

controls.title: Container Metadata & Compose Labels
controls.rationale: Label-urile containerelor ofera vizibilitate asupra provenienta deployment-ului si facilitateaza auditabilitatea. Containerele oprite de mult timp reprezinta acumulare de suprafata de atac.

automatedChecks.title: Labels Docker Compose sau custom
automatedChecks.description: Verifica prezenta label-urilor de tracking (compose project, owner, environment)
automatedChecks.command: LABELS=$({{RUNTIME}} inspect --format '{{json .Config.Labels}}' {{CONTAINER_ID}} 2>/dev/null); echo "LABELS=$LABELS"; HAS_COMPOSE=$(echo "$LABELS" | grep -c 'com.docker.compose' || true); HAS_LABELS=$(echo "$LABELS" | grep -c '".*":' || true); if [ "$HAS_LABELS" -gt 0 ]; then echo 'CHECK=PASS'; else echo 'LABELS=EMPTY'; echo 'CHECK=WARN'; fi
automatedChecks.onFailMessage: Containerul nu are label-uri configurate. Adaugati label-uri pentru tracking: environment, owner, version, project.

automatedChecks.title: Starea containerului si durata (running vs stopped)
automatedChecks.description: Verificarea statusului si timpului de la ultima pornire/oprire
automatedChecks.command: STATUS=$({{RUNTIME}} inspect --format '{{.State.Status}}' {{CONTAINER_ID}} 2>/dev/null); STARTED=$({{RUNTIME}} inspect --format '{{.State.StartedAt}}' {{CONTAINER_ID}} 2>/dev/null); FINISHED=$({{RUNTIME}} inspect --format '{{.State.FinishedAt}}' {{CONTAINER_ID}} 2>/dev/null); echo "STATUS=$STATUS"; echo "STARTED=$STARTED"; echo "FINISHED=$FINISHED"; echo 'CHECK=PASS'

manualChecks.title: Politica containere oprite (cleanup)
manualChecks.description: Exista o politica de curatare pentru containere oprite de mult timp?
manualChecks.instructions: Confirmati ca exista un proces automat sau manual de curatare a containerelor oprite si a imaginilor nefolositoare.

manualChecks.title: Revizie politici admission control (Kubernetes/OPA)
manualChecks.description: Daca containerele sunt orchestrate, exista politici de admission control (OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno)?
manualChecks.instructions: Documentati daca se foloseste admission control pentru a impune politici de securitate la nivel de cluster.
